note: #306 / A13. The control reverts the ORACLE rather than the behaviour. A RED obtained by removing the test proves the test can be removed, not that it detects anything — the strongest-looking evidence in the manifest and the emptiest. The gate must refuse a control whose paths are test paths, with diff_scope.py owning what 'test path' means (#280). Narrated lane on purpose: with --execute-nc a revert of an unchanged file is a no-op that #255 already refuses, so an executed version of this trap would pass without #280 and measure nothing about it. Measured layering: the TEST-path branch of _bind_paths_to_change fires first; with that branch disabled the not-changed branch still catches it, because this fixture's test predates the fix. Isolating the test-path rule alone would need a fixture whose test is ADDED at head_sha, which is the TDD shape — noted rather than built, since the trap already measures the bind.
